newsitem.title: USA: Marriott issues Renaissance tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Marriott issues Renaissance tender offer.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said Monday it has made a tender offer to purchase all of Renaissance Hotel Group NV's outstanding shares of common stock at $30 net per share.
The offer and withdrawal rights are to expire at 1201 EST/1701 GMT Saturday, March 29, unless extended by Marriott.
Earlier this month, Marriott said it had agreed to acquire Renaissance in a transaction valued at $1 billion. Combined, the two companies would have 1,300 hotels worldwide, across 10 brands.
